meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会系统地完整阅读代码库中的每一个源文件，并逐页读取大文件，以建立对代码库的深入理解。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目或不熟悉的项目，或要求 Claude“学习代码库”“阅读代码库”等时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始逐个读取所有源文件。

say.text: 阅读整个代码库，帮我熟悉项目
帮我预热代码库，了解项目结构
say.note: 通过完整阅读来建立认知。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude systematically reads every source file in full, paging through large files, to build a deep understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to 'learn the codebase', 'read the codebase', or 'prime'.

say_en.note: Claude starts reading all source files.

say_en.text: Read the entire codebase to help me get familiar.
Help me prime the codebase and understand the project structure.
